layout.hierarchy: The schematic dominates absolutely; there is no title. Largest text: vertical 'Encoder' (red) and 'Decoder' (green) bold-italic panel labels (~36-40pt). Next: the tri-color 'Encoder / Decoder / Attention' caption and 'Encoder Block N' bar labels (~12-16pt). Then bar captions (~9-11pt bold). Smallest: X/Y subscripts, Word labels, and tiny white text inside the blue attention boxes (~6-7pt). The thick red and green container borders are the strongest structural cues; color (red/green/blue/purple) carries more weight than text size.

visual_elements.description: ENCODER PANEL: red-bordered container with vertical red bold-italic 'Encoder' on its left edge. Top row: eight small yellow rectangles with red borders labeled Y_0, Y_1, Y_2, Y_3, Y_4, Y_5, then a blue six-dot ellipsis, then Y_{N-1}, Y_N. Below, a light-purple backdrop holds four dark-purple bars with white bold text, top to bottom: 'Encoder Block M', 'Encoder Block 2', 'Encoder Block 1', 'Encoder Block 0'; each gap between bars (and above the top bar) contains ~6 vertical columns of small navy dots with a red upward arrow per column; a row of red up-arrows also runs between the stack top and the Y row. Below the stack: row of yellow boxes X_0...X_5, blue ellipsis, X_{N-1}, X_N; then a tan full-width bar 'Word Embedding' (red text); then a pale-blue bar 'Positional Encoding / Embedding' (blue text); then bottom row of yellow boxes labeled Word 0, Word 1, Word 2, Word 3, Word 4, Word 5, a gray dotted ellipsis, Word N-2, Word N-1, with ~8 small blue up-arrows from the word boxes to the pale-blue bar. Implied flow bottom-to-top: words -> positional/word embedding -> X tokens -> Encoder Blocks 0...M -> Y tokens.

visual_elements.description: CENTRAL COLUMN + ARROWS: tall narrow column (~1.5% slide width) filled with dense horizontal blue stripes on white, representing the stack of encoder output vectors; thin blue connector lines run from its top and fan left down to each Y box. A thin diagonal blue line crosses at the column's bottom tip. Below the column sits the tri-color caption stacked on three lines: 'Encoder' (red bold italic), 'Decoder' (green bold italic), 'Attention' (blue bold italic).

recreation_brief:
1) Blank white 16:9 slide; no title. Optionally add a full-width black rectangle (~0.4 cm tall) along the bottom edge to mimic the video frame.
2) Encoder container: rectangle ~4%-48% width, ~7%-96% height, no fill, 3pt red (#FF0000) outline. Insert vertical text box 'Encoder' (Arial 36pt bold italic, red), rotated 270 degrees, hugging the container's left edge, vertically centered.
3) Block stack: light-purple (#D9D2E9) rectangle ~10%-46% width, ~27%-67% height. Inside, four dark-purple (#4A4AA8) bars with white Arial 12pt bold text, top to bottom: 'Encoder Block M', 'Encoder Block 2', 'Encoder Block 1', 'Encoder Block 0'. In each gap (and above the top bar) place ~6 columns of small navy (#000080) dots plus one red up-arrow per column; add a row of red up-arrows between the stack top and the Y row.
4) Y row (top): eight yellow (#FFFF99) rectangles with red outlines; red italic serif labels Y_0, Y_1, Y_2, Y_3, Y_4, Y_5, then a blue '• • • • • •' text box, then Y_{N-1}, Y_N.
5) X row (below stack): identical boxes labeled X_0 ... X_5, blue dots, X_{N-1}, X_N.
6) Below X row: tan (#F8CBAD) full-width bar with red bold 'Word Embedding'; beneath it a pale-blue (#DDEBF7) bar with blue bold 'Positional Encoding / Embedding'.
7) Word row (bottom): yellow boxes labeled Word 0, Word 1, Word 2, Word 3, Word 4, Word 5, a gray '○○○○○○' ellipsis, Word N-2, Word N-1; draw ~8 small blue (#2E64FE) up-arrows from these boxes to the pale-blue bar.
8) Central column: narrow rectangle (~1.5% width, ~10%-78% height) filled with dense horizontal blue (#2E64FE) stripes; draw thin blue connector lines from each Y box top routing up and right into the column top; add a thin diagonal blue line at the column's bottom tip.
9) K/V/Q badges: yellow circles with red outlines and red bold letters. 'K' at ~(57%, 30%) and 'V' at ~(57%, 50%), each with a thick red right-arrow into the decoder; add ~4 hatched blue/white striped right-arrows between them and two solid dark-blue right-arrows at ~57% and ~73% heights. Place 'Q' at ~(88%, 78%) with a thick red up-arrow into the Masked Multi-Headed Attention row.
10) Caption under the column: three stacked bold-italic lines, 'Encoder' (red), 'Decoder' (green), 'Attention' (blue), ~16pt, centered at ~(52%, 85%).
11) Decoder container: rectangle ~56%-90% width, ~7%-96% height, no fill, 3pt green (#00B050) outline; vertical green bold-italic 'Decoder' label along its right inner edge.
12) Decoder stack, top to bottom: (a) tiny red 'Tokens' label over a row of 10 white circles with red outlines; (b) row of 10 magenta (#FF00FF) circles; (c) row of 10 green (#00B050) circles; connect all three rows with thin lines (fully-connected look). Then: red (#C00000) bar with white bold 'Residual Connection and Layer Normalization'; green (#00B050) bar with yellow bold 'Feed Forward Networks - One Hidden with RELU Activation'; row of six blue (#2E75B6) boxes with white bold 'Encoder Decoder Attention' (tiny sub-label 'Multi-Head' [?] optional; small yellow 'K'/'V' tags at the row's left edge); another red 'Residual Connection and Layer Normalization' bar; a second row of six 'Encoder Decoder Attention' boxes; a row of six small gray (#BFBFBF) squares; then repeat red bar + green FFN bar + a third row of six 'Encoder Decoder Attention' boxes.
13) Continue downward: red 'Residual Connection and Layer Normalization' bar; row of six blue boxes 'Masked Multi-Headed Attention'; purple (#7030A0) bar with white bold 'Word and Position Embedding' plus tiny blue end-labels 'POS' (left) and 'm/t/de' [?] (right); finish with a row of small yellow token boxes beneath.
14) Slide number: yellow circle with red outline and red bold '57' at ~(94%, 8%).
